applications.notes: Confirm current version, signatures, credentials and publishing role before any action
Discover identifiers and publication state from connected authorized accounts; do not infer

storeChecklist: Check signing and release artifact SHA256
Validate screenshots, Arabic text, privacy and policy declarations
Choose internal testing or production explicitly
Request explicit owner approval for each upload/submission and separately for rollout
Log authorized action and exact platform response
Never commit keys, certificates, signing files or service account JSON
